June 26th, 1944. One of the main Allied objectives in Operation Overlord was to capture the city of Caen and the nearby airfield at Carpiquet.

December 22nd, 1941. American forces in the Philippines pose a major threat to the advance of Japanese to the south, so the capture of Luzon Island is an important part of the Japanese plans to gain dominance in South-East Asia.

October 31st, 1943. Soviet forces are preparing the largest landing operation on the Eastern Front with the aim of liberating the city and port of Kerch, the port of Kamysh-Burun and creating a bridgehead for the further liberation of the Crimean Peninsula from German invaders.

An alternate history operation. July 25th, 1985. A chain of political and economic events has led to increased tension between the Warsaw Pact and NATO countries. The armed forces of both blocks have been put on alert in accordance with the adopted directives. Soviet forces rely on a powerful tank group, the operation of which two lowlands in the mountaneous area of Hesse — the Fulda Gap — are well suited.

October 17th, 1973. Israeli forces have crossed the Suez Canal and entrenched themselves on its west bank. The Egyptian command plans a counterattack near the Chinese Farm with the aim of encircling the enemy and regaining control of the Tirtur and Akawish roads.
